title: reset_clone also removes a previous area's local branches and stash
goal: bench_repro.reset_clone leaves the clone with only its main branch and no stash entries, so a branch or stash a previous area's /kb-research session made does not reach the next area

run:
import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda c,*a:subprocess.run(['git','-C',c,'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','-c','core.hooksPath=/dev/null',*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
w=os.path.join(t,'w');os.makedirs(w);g(w,'init','-q','-b','main');open(os.path.join(w,'a'),'w').write('a');g(w,'add','-A');g(w,'commit','-qm','s')
o=os.path.join(t,'o.git');g(t,'clone','-q','--bare',w,o);c=os.path.join(t,'c');g(t,'clone','-q',o,c);g(c,'branch','work/1')
b.reset_clone(c,dict(os.environ))
br=g(c,'branch','--list','work/*').stdout.strip();print(repr(br));sys.exit(1 if br else 0)

notes: Review gap of SP-ysuvdxsn, rated S3 by the sprint's reviewer.
